head: NostalgicPod turns your iPhone into a retro music player
dek: NostalgicPod is a music player in the style of classic players, for your own music library, home media servers, internet radio and podcasts. It was #11 among paid Music apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: It costs $4.99 with in-app purchases, by Jesus Manuel Curreri.
means: If you miss scrolling a wheel to pick a song, it brings that back for your own music.
todo: Find NostalgicPod in the App Store.
